description: This file implements a driver for the u-blox 6M GPS module, including functions for initializing, reading, and processing GPS data over UART communication. It manages GPS message parsing, thread handling, and provides functionality to retrieve speed and location information.

methods.name: getCurrentSpeed
methods.description: Returns the current speed from GPS data.

methods.name: printGpsInfo
methods.description: Prints GPS information and status messages.

methods.name: onGpsMessage
methods.description: Processes incoming GPS NMEA messages and updates GPS data.

methods.name: GpsThreadEntryPoint
methods.description: Thread function that reads from GPS serial stream, assembles GPS messages, and processes them.

methods.name: isGpsEnabled
methods.description: Checks whether GPS RX and TX pins are configured.

methods.name: initGps
methods.description: Initializes GPS module, configures UART, assigns pins, starts GPS thread, and adds console action.
